blocks.text: The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM) Yojana is transforming the way farmers access energy. By enabling the use of solar power for irrigation and agriculture, the scheme not only lowers costs but also creates income opportunities and supports India’s renewable energy mission.
At EnerMAN Technologies, we empower farmers, EPC companies, and IPPs with smart IoT SCADA panels that ensure efficient performance and scalability of PM-KUSUM solar projects.

The PM-KUSUM Yojana was launched by the Government of India to accelerate solar adoption in agriculture. Farmers can install solar pumps, grid-connected solar plants, and decentralized renewable projects with up to 60% subsidy support. This scheme benefits not only farmers but also large-scale developers, EPC contractors, and Independent Power Producers (IPPs) who implement these projects across India.
